spa_and_wellness.name: MSC Aurea Spa
spa_and_wellness.description: An authentic Balinese-themed luxury spa complex measuring 1,100 m² (11,840 sq ft) with 20 private therapy treatment rooms.

sub_venues.name: The Thermal Suite
sub_venues.description: Comprehensive hydrotherapy and thermal wellness circuit featuring a light steam room, dark steam room, Mediterranean sauna, Finnish sauna, thalassotherapy hot tubs, snow room (snow grotto), salt room, and two thalassotherapy pools.

sub_venues.name: Aurea Therapies & Treatment Suites
sub_venues.description: Therapies performed by certified Balinese practitioners, offering holistic massage packages (candle massage, sea shell massage, traditional Balinese, Thai massage), personalized facials, and targeted anti-cellulite routines.

sub_venues.name: Jean Louis David Salon
sub_venues.description: A professional branded salon offering comprehensive hair-care treatments, styling, coloring, professional nail therapy (manicures/pedicures), waxing, and dedicated men’s grooming/barber services.

sub_venues.name: Aurea Spa Bar
sub_venues.description: A dedicated wellness juice and tea bar offering organic herbal teas, freshly squeezed fruit juices, and revitalizing health elixirs.
